rows.quote: The markets for analytical instruments in which we compete are characterized by evolving industry standards and intense competition. Our principal competitors in the life sciences arena include: Bruker Corp., Danaher Corporation, Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. and Waters Corp. Agilent competes on the basis of product performance, reliability, support quality, applications expertise, global channel coverage and price.
rows.note: 3セグメント全てで『intense competition』＋競合を複数名指しし、競争要因に price を挙げる。'qualif'12件は全て供給網の複数調達とヘッジ会計で、顧客側の再認定・スイッチングコストの記述はゼロ（switch/sole source/barriers to entry は0件）。

rows.quote: The Company believes that each aspect of its business is highly competitive and that such competition is based primarily on price and quality of service. The Company provides nearly all its services under contracts originally obtained through competitive bidding. The low cost of entry in the facility services business results in a very competitive market, and the Company experiences competition from a large number of mostly regional and local owner-operated companies, primarily located in major cities throughout the United States.
rows.note: 会社自身が『low cost of entry』『competitive bidding』『competition ... based primarily on price』と三重に代替容易性を述べる。'certif'24件は全て集団訴訟のクラス認定と年金プランの認証。

rows.quote: The professional technical and management support services markets we serve are highly fragmented and we compete with a large number of regional, national and international companies. Certain of these competitors have greater financial and other resources than we do.
rows.note: 原本が市場を『highly fragmented』と明言。ISO9001は当社が取得する側の認証で規約上85に当たらない。顧客側の再認定・移行摩擦の記述なし。

rows.quote: The home and community based services industry is highly competitive, fragmented and market specific. Each local market has its own competitive profile and no single competitor has significant market share across all of our markets.
rows.note: 別途『Our industry is highly competitive, fragmented and market-specific, with limited barriers to entry.』とも明記。州の免許・認証は当社が取得する側。契約は60日通知で解約可と原本が述べる。

rows.quote: The hotel industry is highly competitive and the hotels in which we invest are subject to competition from other hotels for guests. Competition is based on a number of factors, most notably convenience of location, brand affiliation, price, range of services, guest amenities or accommodations offered and quality of customer service.
rows.note: ホテルREIT。競争要因は立地・ブランド・価格で、顧客(宿泊客)側に移行障壁は原理的に無い。'qualif'53件は全てREIT税制の適格要件。

rows.quote: The Company’s products are sold in highly competitive markets throughout the world. The principal competitive factors are price, quality, availability, service and reputation. The Company competes with several large national and international companies that offer a broad range of equipment and replacement parts, as well as with numerous small, privately-held manufacturers and suppliers of a limited number of products, mainly on a regional basis.
rows.note: 競争要因の筆頭が price、かつ大手複数＋『numerous small』の同等品供給者を自ら列挙。認定・設計組込・スイッチングコストの記述は全文にゼロ。

rows.quote: AMETEK’s aerospace products are designed to customer specifications and are manufactured to stringent operational and reliability requirements. Its aerospace business operates in specialized markets, where its products have a technological and/or cost advantage.
rows.note: 設計組込は全社レベルでも『the manufacture of customized products for its customers』と述べ70に届く。だが顧客側の再認定は皆無（'qualif'5件は全て人材採用と会計）で、Competition節は『most of the Company’s markets are highly competitive』＋価格を挙げる＝85には全く届かない。

rows.quote: We compete with dealers that sell the same vehicle brands that we sell, as well as those that sell other vehicle brands that we do not represent in a particular market. Our new vehicle store competitors have franchise agreements with the various vehicle manufacturers and, as such, generally have access to new vehicles on the same terms as we have.
rows.note: 競合が同一ブランドを同一条件で仕入れられると原本が明言＝代替容易の直接証拠。米国のフランチャイズ店15,900・独立中古車店37,900と規模も自ら開示。ブランド別の販売地域指定は参入制限だが顧客側の移行障壁ではない。

rows.quote: There are more than 4,000 U.S. colleges and universities serving traditional college-age students and adult students. Competition is highly fragmented and varies by geography, program offerings, delivery method, ownership, quality level, and selectivity of admissions. No one institution has a significant share of the total postsecondary market.
rows.note: 原本が『highly fragmented』『No one institution has a significant share』と明記。認定(accreditation)・Title IV適格は当社が取得する側の認証で規約上85に当たらない。学生側の再認定負担の記述なし。

rows.quote: The industry verticals in which we engage are highly competitive and generally consist of a few national vendors as well as a large number of regional, local or in-house providers resulting in a fragmented market with disparate service offerings.
rows.note: 2020年までのOcwen/OMS契約はあるが、原本自身が『Ocwen and OMS are not restricted from redeveloping these services.』『We compete ... against both third parties and the in-house capabilities of our customers.』と移行障壁の不在を述べる＝長期契約は85の根拠にならない。

rows.quote: Competition in our industry is intense and we expect competition to increase in the future. Our competitors currently sell products that provide similar benefits to those that we sell.
rows.note: 20-F FY2012。Competition節の冒頭が「競合は同等の便益の製品を売っている」と明言し、全製品ラインで Cisco/Huawei/Broadcom 等を多数名指し（TERの50と同型）。design win・6-12ヶ月の統合期間という70側の摩擦も併存するが、リスク要因が『our products can become outmoded or obsolete in a relatively short period of time』と自ら述べるため、全社ベースでは代替容易の側で確定した。

rows.quote: We believe that our strong relationship with our customers, our large installed base of products, the significant amount of medical and safety testing already performed on our products, our world-class customer service and other support we provide to customers (legal support, product liability coverage, education, etc.) provides us with a strong competitive advantage.
rows.note: 10-K FY2012。顧客側の再認定の記述はゼロ（安全性試験は当社が実施した側＝85不該当）。軍向けには『We are the only supplier providing CEWs to these military agencies』と述べるが、法執行市場ではKarbon Armsという競合を名指しするので全社100は取れない。既設置基盤・専用カートリッジ・長期関係で70。

rows.quote: For each of our operating segments, the market can be generally categorized as highly competitive with many players. The market can be influenced by economic downturns as some competitors that are highly leveraged both financially and operationally could become more aggressive in their pricing of products. The principal competitive factors in all our product markets are product features, availability, price, customer support, and distribution coverage. The relative importance of each of these factors varies depending on the customer. Some products are manufactured to meet published industry specifications and are less differentiated on the basis of product characteristics.
rows.note: 10-K FY2012。『published industry specifications に合わせて作られ差別化が乏しい製品がある』『各セグメントとも多数のプレイヤーで高度に競争的』と原本が自認。認証・qualificationの語は自社取得のものすら無く、販売は流通経由・銅価格連動＝50で確定。

rows.quote: The dermatology competitive landscape is highly fragmented, with a large number of mid-size and smaller companies competing in both the prescription sector and the OTC and cosmeceutical sectors.
rows.note: 10-K FY2012（Valeant）。主戦場を自ら highly fragmented と述べ、独占失効時は『substituted by pharmacies』＝薬局が自動置換できると明記。個別特許の排他性はあるが顧客側の再認定は皆無で、規約の50（代替容易・多数供給）に該当。

rows.quote: We compete with both online and traditional travel reservation services. The market for the travel reservation services we offer is intensely competitive, and current and new competitors can launch new services at a relatively low cost.
rows.note: 10-K FY2012（priceline.com）。『新規競合が比較的低コストでサービスを立ち上げられる』と原本が明言し、BackBid/Hipmunk/Room 77等の新規参入を列挙、Google/Apple/Microsoftの脅威も自認。ブランドと宿泊供給網は強いが、顧客側の移行摩擦の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: Direct costs that are incurred to set up or convert a client’s systems to function with the Company’s technology are generally deferred and recognized on a straight-line basis which commences after client acceptance when the processing term begins.
rows.note: 10-K FY2012（6月期）。顧客システムを当社技術に合わせて転換する費用がBSに繰延資産として立つ＝深い統合の実物証拠。10〜11年のMSA、『mission-critical functions』としてFFIEC検査対象、大型受注は収益化まで12-24ヶ月。ただし顧客側の再認定の断定は無いので85には届かない。

rows.quote: The market for blade, drivetrain and field services in which our Services segment competes is highly fragmented, and includes OEMs such as GE Services and Siemens, large-scale service providers such as enXco, and a number of independent service providers, including Outland Energy Services and UpWind Solutions.
rows.note: 10-K FY2012。自ら highly fragmented と述べ、顧客自身が内製能力を持つとも明記。中国・ベトナム製タワーのダンピング（マージン45-70%）を提訴中＝価格が全て。認証はISO9001の自社取得のみ＝85不該当。

rows.quote: installation of the systems at the customer’s site for side-by-side competitive evaluations for a period of approximately six months. More evaluation time is devoted during the initial penetration period for several new products such as the Xact product line (see Item 4.B – Business Overview – Product Lines ), and for new customers in new markets, since these circumstances usually require qualification of the systems by the customers and engineering efforts to fix errors, customize tasks and add new features.
rows.note: 20-F FY2012。『顧客による装置のqualificationが必要』と顧客側の負担を明記し評価期間は約6ヶ月＝高摩擦。ただし文脈は当社が新規採用してもらう側の販売プロセス（願望形）で、『side-by-side competitive evaluations』＝顧客は常時横並び比較する、と自ら書く。再認定で既存を守るという断定は無いので85ではなく70。

rows.quote: Food and beverage cans are standardized products, allowing for relatively little differentiation among competitors. This could lead to overcapacity and price competition among food and beverage can producers.
rows.note: 10-K FY2012（Crown Holdings）。『標準化製品で競合間の差別化がほとんど無い』と原本が明言し、Ball/Rexam/Silgan等を名指し、北米・西欧は成熟＋過剰能力。ガラス・紙・樹脂という代替素材の脅威も自認＝50。

rows.quote: We compete with U.S. and international companies in the aluminum industry primarily in the areas of price, quality and service. In addition, aluminum competes with materials such as steel, copper, carbon fiber, composites, plastic and glass, each of which may be substituted for aluminum in certain applications.
rows.note: 10-K FY2012。一次アルミ＝価格で競争し他素材にも置換されうると原本が明記（コモディティ）。Hawesvilleの溶湯供給・高純度アルミ首位という局所優位はあるが、売上85%がGlencore/Southwire/BHPの3社＝存続級の取引相手依存の側。認証・qualification記述なし。

rows.quote: The market for information and network security solutions is intensely competitive and we expect that competition will continue to increase in the future. Our competitors include Cisco Systems, Inc., Juniper Networks, Inc., Fortinet Inc., SonicWall Inc. (acquired by Dell Inc.), Palo Alto Networks, Inc., WatchGuard Technologies, Inc., McAfee, Inc. (acquired by Intel Corporation), Sourcefire, Inc. and other companies in the network security space. We also compete with several other companies, including Microsoft Corporation, Symantec Corporation, International Business Machines Corporation, Hewlett-Packard and Websense Inc. with respect to specific products that we offer. There are hundreds of small and large companies that offer security products and services that we may compete with from time to time.
rows.note: 20-F(2013-03-19)。顧客側の再認定・スイッチングコスト・installed base ロックの記述をパターン走査したが一つも無く、Competition節は自ら『hundreds of small and large companies』と価格競争(『offered ... their products at lower prices than we do』)を述べる＝残余刻み50。certificationの語は自社の教育認定とSOX証明のみ。

rows.quote: The software market is highly competitive. Pricing is very aggressive in both software distribution and reselling. The Company expects pricing pressure to continue. The Company faces competition from a wide variety of sources. In the Lifeboat Distribution segment, we compete against much larger broad-line distributors, as well as specialty distributors and, in some cases, the direct sales teams of the vendors we represent also sell directly to the end-customers.
rows.note: 当時はWayside Technology Group(ソフト卸・VAR)。自ら『Pricing is very aggressive』『lowered the barriers for competition』と述べ、仕入先ベンダーが直販で顧客を奪う構造も明記＝代替容易の50。qualification/認定の語は皆無。

rows.quote: The markets in which we operate are highly competitive. We compete worldwide with a number of other manufacturers and distributors that produce and sell similar products. We primarily compete in the market with diesel engines and related diesel products; however, new technologies continue to be developed for gasoline, natural gas and other technologies and we will continue to face new competition from these expanding technologies. Our products primarily compete on the basis of price, performance, fuel economy, speed of delivery, quality and customer support.
rows.note: 『similar products』『compete on the basis of price』＝50。certificationはEPA/EU が当社エンジンを認証する自社取得側で不該当。むしろリスク項目は『Our truck manufacturers and OEMs customers may not continue to outsource their engine supply needs』＝顧客の内製化リスクを自認し、ロックの逆を述べている。

rows.quote: There are no other electric transmission and distribution utilities in CenterPoint Houston's service area. In order for another provider of transmission and distribution services to provide such services in CenterPoint Houston's territory, it would be required to obtain a certificate of convenience and necessity from the Texas Utility Commission and, depending on the location of the facilities, may also be required to obtain franchises from one or more municipalities. We know of no other party intending to enter this business in CenterPoint Houston's service area at this time.
rows.note: 送配電区域内に代替供給者が存在しないと原本が断定＝100。ただし機構は規制フランチャイズ独占であって認定ロックではない(mech=なし)。全社では割れる——Gas Operationsは『competes primarily with alternate energy sources』、CESとInterstate Pipelinesは競合ありと同じ10-Kが述べる。刻みは最大収益源の電力T&Dで採った。

rows.quote: Our industry is highly competitive, based on factors such as price, merchandise quality and selection, warehouse location and member service.
rows.note: 続けて『We compete with over 800 warehouse club locations』『every major metropolitan area has multiple club operations』『Competitors such as Wal-Mart, Target, Kohl's and Amazon.com』と述べる＝50。会員制の更新はあるが顧客側の再認定・移行費用の記述は無い。堀(規模の経済・会員費)は強いが irr の型ではないので moat5 側にだけ反映した。

rows.quote: The market for marketing technologies, including digital signage, is highly competitive and we expect competition to increase in the future. Some of our competitors or potential competitors may have significantly greater financial, technical and marketing resources than our company. These competitors may be able to respond more rapidly than we can to new or emerging technologies.
rows.note: 当時はWireless Ronin Technologies(デジタルサイネージ)。ComQi/Stratacache/Broadsign/Scala等を名指しし『rapidly changing technology, evolving industry standards ... heavy competition』と自認。認定・移行障壁の記述ゼロ＝50。

rows.quote: Some of these companies compete across many of our product lines, while others are primarily focused in a specific product area. Barriers to entry are relatively low, and new ventures to create products that do or could compete with our products are regularly formed. In addition, some of our competitors may have greater resources, including technical and engineering resources, than we do.
rows.note: 『Barriers to entry are relatively low』と会社自身が明記＝ADBE型の自認で50。『price-focused competition from competitors in Asia, especially from China』も併記。certificationは自社製造のISO9001/9003取得(自社取得側)のみで顧客側の再認定は無し。installed baseの語はサービス収益の説明で出るだけでロックの主張ではない。

rows.quote: The real estate business, generally, is highly competitive and fragmented.
rows.note: Consolidated-Tomoka Land。『fragmented』を自ら明記＝規約(3)の残余刻み50が数値なしで確定。収益物件取得も『price is the principal method of competition』、ゴルフ事業も『largely based on price』。顧客の移行障壁の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: We face competition in our role as both a prime contractor to the U.S. government and as a subcontractor to military and commercial aircraft manufacturers. We compete with numerous larger, well-established prime contractors engaged in the supply of aircraft parts and assemblies to the military, including NGC, Lockheed, Boeing, The Nordam Group and Triumph. All of these competitors possess significantly larger infrastructures, greater resources and the capabilities to respond to much larger contracts.
rows.note: CPI Aerostructures。全社では『We obtain contracts for our products and services through the process of competitive bidding』＝価格入札で50。単一部品では『are the only supplier of C-5A wing-tips to the U.S. government』と唯一供給を述べるが、当該TOP契約の発注期間は2011年に終了しており全社の刻みを決めない。qualificationの語は人材と新プログラムの規制認証だけで、顧客側の再認定の記述は無い。

rows.quote: The airline industry is highly competitive, marked by significant competition with respect to routes, fares, schedules (both timing and frequency), services, products, customer service and frequent flyer programs.
rows.note: 『competition with respect to ... fares』＝価格競争を自認し、ハブ空港でも『some of which may have lower costs than we do and provide service at low fares to destinations served by us』と述べる＝50。certificationはFAAの運航証明(自社取得側)の話で不該当。

rows.quote: We compete with a number of developers, owners and operators of office and commercial real estate, many of which own properties similar to ours in the same markets in which our properties are located.
rows.note: 不動産賃貸(10-K filed 2013-02-27)。競合が同一サブマーケットで同種物件を保有すると自認し、テナント側の再認定・移行費用の記述は皆無。『high barriers to entry』は submarket の供給制約＝貸主側の話で、顧客の移行障壁ではない。

rows.quote: For many types of CE products, our technologies are included in explicit industry standards, as standards-setting bodies mandate their inclusion in a particular type of product. For example, Dolby Digital is the standard audio technology for digital televisions in North America and is mandated in all DVD and Blu-ray Disc players worldwide.
rows.note: 第三者(標準化団体)が製品カテゴリ＝用途ごとに採用を義務化『済み』で、OEMは代替すると規格非適合になる＝規格ロックの完了形。減点材料も記録: de facto標準依存部分があり、Competition節はDTS/Fraunhofer等を名指し、将来規格への採用は『we make significant efforts ... to have our technologies adopted as industry standards』と願望形で書かれている。

rows.quote: The restaurant industry is intensely competitive with respect to the type and quality of food, price, service, restaurant location, personnel, brand, attractiveness of facilities, and effectiveness of advertising and marketing.
rows.note: 外食(10-K filed 2012-07-20)。原本自身が『there are many well-established competitors』『We compete within each market with national and regional chains and locally-owned restaurants』と述べる。認定・移行障壁の記述なし。仕入側も『alternative qualified suppliers』と代替容易を自認。

rows.quote: The barriers to entry into these channels can be low, and businesses easily can launch online sites or mobile applications at nominal cost by using commercially available software or partnering with any of a number of successful ecommerce companies.
rows.note: 原本自身が参入障壁の低さと代替チャネルの多さ(『our users can find, buy, sell and pay for similar items through a variety of competing online, mobile and offline channels』)を明記。switching/認定の記述はゼロ(switchの用例は『乗り換えられてしまう』側)。マーケットプレイスとPayPalのネットワーク効果は主観のmoat5でのみ評価。

rows.quote: The relatively low barriers to entry into the lighting industry and the limited proprietary nature of many lighting products also permit new competitors to enter the industry easily.
rows.note: LED照明(10-K filed 2013-03-27)。認証はUL/ETLの自社取得で、しかも『although not legally required to do so, we strive to obtain certification』＝規約の除外項目(自社取得＋願望形)。米海軍は売上13%の顧客集中だが、顧客側の再認定の記述は無い。

rows.quote: The global PCB industry is highly fragmented and intensely competitive.
rows.note: PCB製造(20-F filed 2013-04-30)。DoD Qualified Product List(MIL-PRF-55110G)承認とITAR登録はいずれも『自社が取得する側』の認証で除外項目。しかも防衛市場は『our efforts to enter into to the U.S. defense market may not succeed』＝願望形。ISO9001/14001も自社取得。

rows.quote: Because one of our strategies has been to develop long-term relationships with key customers in the product areas in which we focus, and because we have a long product design and development cycle for most of our products and prospective customers typically require lengthy product qualification periods prior to placing volume orders, we may be unable to replace these customers quickly or at all.
rows.note: 『顧客の長い製品認定期間』は規約が70に置く『長い評価期間』そのもの。文書内の qualif 全12箇所を確認したが顧客側の再認定の断定は無く(85の型の文言なし)、Competition節は逆に『The market for our products is highly fragmented, and we compete with a number of different companies』と述べる。材料変更時の『the risks associated with qualifying new polymers with our customers』は自社供給リスクの文脈で、85の断定には足りないと判断した。

rows.quote: We employ our vessels in highly competitive markets that are capital intensive and highly fragmented.
rows.note: 海運(20-F filed 2013-04-30)。原本自身が highly fragmented・価格競争(『Competition ... depends on price, location, size, age, condition』)と明記。ISMコード/船級証書は規制順守で自社(船側)が取得するもの＝除外項目。

rows.quote: The products sold by us are commodities and competition among manufacturers is based largely on price.
rows.note: セメント・石膏ボード(10-K filed 2013-05-24)。原本自ら『The cement industry is extremely competitive as a result of multiple domestic suppliers』『Barriers to entry in each industry are low, except with respect to environmental permitting』と述べる。輸送コストによる地理的な擁壁はあるが顧客の再認定・移行障壁の記述は無い。

rows.quote: the express package and freight markets are both highly competitive and sensitive to price and service, especially in periods of little or no macro-economic growth
rows.note: 物流(10-K filed 2012-07-16)。原本自身が価格感応的な激競争と述べる。ISO9001は『required by thousands of customers』と書かれるが自社取得の認証＝除外項目。顧客システムとの統合も『designed to be easily integrated into our customers' applications』＝摩擦の低さを自認しており移行障壁の主張ではない。ネットワーク密度の堀はmoat5でのみ評価。

rows.quote: The HVAC industry is highly competitive and consists of thousands of local and regional companies. We believe that purchasing decisions in the commercial, industrial and institutional markets are based on (i) competitive price, (ii) long-term customer relationships, (iii) quality, timeliness and reliability of services provided
rows.note: 自社が『低い参入障壁』『a large portion of our work is awarded through a bid process. Consequently, price is often the principal factor』と明言。qualification/認定語の走査は Clean Air Act の自社技術者認定(自社取得側)しか当たらず85は不成立。

rows.quote: In addition, there are relatively few barriers to entry into our market, and new competitors could readily seek to compete against us in one or more market segments addressed by our research.
rows.note: 会費制メンバーシップの更新収益はあるが、原本は参入障壁が低く競合が容易に参入できると自認。顧客側の再認定・移行摩擦の記述は皆無で50。

rows.quote: The markets in which we operate are highly competitive. Many of our competitors have significantly greater financial resources than we do. The intensity of this competition, which is expected to continue, can result in price discounting and margin pressures throughout the industry and may adversely affect our ability to increase or maintain prices for our products.
rows.note: 『purchase decisions are made based on competitive bidding, price, reputation, performance and servicing』『contracts with municipal and other governmental customers are in some cases awarded and renewed through competitive bidding』＝入札で毎回競争。EN/NFPA/ANSI準拠は当社が満たす規格で顧客側の再認定ではない。

rows.quote: We deploy our vessels in highly competitive markets that are capital intensive. Competition arises primarily from other vessel owners, some of which have greater resources than we do. Competition for the transportation of LPG, refined petroleum products and crude oil can be intense and depends on price, location, size, age, condition and the accepta
rows.note: LPG船のスポット/期間用船＝コモディティ輸送。ISM Code認証は当社が保持する側の認証で85には当たらない。

rows.quote: The non-powered landscaping product industry is highly competitive and fragmented. Most competitors consist of small, privately-held companies focusing on a single product category.
rows.note: 全社ベースで50。Telephonics だけ『its incumbent status on major platforms provides a competitive advantage in the selection process for platform upgrades』＝70寄りの記述があるが同社は連結の約24%（米政府19%÷Telephonics比79%）で、主力のATT(工具)・CBP(ガレージドア)・Plastics は価格競争と自認。

rows.quote: The electronic game industry is intensely competitive and subject to rapid changes in consumer preferences and frequent new product introductions. We compete with mass merchants and regional chains; computer product and consumer electronics stores; other video game and PC software specialty stores; toy retail chains; direct sales by software publishers; and online retailers and game rental companies.
rows.note: 小売。中古買取網で『one of the only suppliers of previous generation platforms』とは述べるが、これは品揃えの話で顧客の移行障壁ではない。デジタル配信という代替経路も同じ節で自認。

rows.quote: The oil and natural gas industry is intensely competitive, and we compete with other companies that have greater resources.
rows.note: E&P＝完全にコモディティ。qualification/認定/設計組込の記述は全文走査でゼロ（当たったのはSOX302証明書のみ）。

rows.quote: Nevertheless, the markets for our products are highly competitive. To date, our sales have been limited to customers within the PRC and we expect that our sales will remain primarily in domestic for the immediate future. Our marketing strategy involves developing long term ongoing working relationships with customers based on large multi-year agreements which foster mutually advantageous relationships. We compete with PRC domestic private companies and state-owned companies.
rows.note: 臭素・粗塩・化学品のコモディティ。長期契約はあるが顧客側の再認定の記述なし。当たった certification は自社が取得する環境認証(PRC Bureau of Environmental Protection)＝85の除外対象。

rows.quote: Our industry is highly competitive, with competition based primarily on customer service, price, store location and appearance, and quality, availability and assortment of merchandise.
rows.note: 堀は規模・立地・ブランド（『one of the most recognized brands in North America』）であって移行障壁ではない。qualified supplier の語は当社が仕入先を選ぶ側の話で85の逆向き。

rows.quote: The contracting services industry is highly competitive. While price is a factor, the ability to acquire specialized vessels, attract and retain skilled personnel, and demonstrate a good safety record is also important. Our principal competitors include Ocean
rows.note: 専用船・飽和潜水など資産の特殊性はあるがOceaneering/Saipem/Fugro/Subsea 7/Technip/McDermott等を名指しで列挙し価格競争を自認。当たった certification は船級の recertification（自社側の定期検査）で85に当たらない。

rows.quote: While several of our competitors are divisions of larger corporations, our industry remains largely fragmented, with several hundred fabricators and toolmakers. Many of our competitors operate relatively small shops, producing a limited selection of tools while buying cemented tungsten carbide components from original producers of cemented tungsten carbide products, including Kennametal.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K(2012-08-13)。COMPETITION節が自ら『largely fragmented』『approximately 30 companies in the United States, with many more offering similar capabilities』と述べる。顧客側の再認定・承認名簿の記述はゼロ（qualif系パターンでヒット0件）。消耗工具で移行摩擦の記述なし。

rows.quote: We encounter significant competition in all of our markets, and we expect this competition to intensify in the future. Many of our primary competitors are well-established companies and some have substantially greater financial, managerial, technical, marketing, operational and other resources than we do.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K(2013-04-02)。各市場で競合を多数名指し（Intellian/Cobham/Honeywell/Northrop等）。文中のqualifyは全て『当社が自分の供給者をqualifyする』側で顧客側ではない。ISO9001は自社取得の認証＝規約で除外。

rows.quote: Many companies offer products that compete with those we manufacture and sell. The number of competing companies varies by product line, but many of the markets for our products are highly competitive. ... Many of our competitors try to win business primarily on price but, depending upon the particular product, we experience competition based on quality, performance and availability as well.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K(2013-02-28)。原本が価格競争と競合多数を明言し『most companies in our lines of business compete primarily on price』とも。顧客側の再認定記述なし（ヒットはDRC紛争鉱物の認証要求のみで移行障壁ではない）。

rows.quote: The lemon, avocado, orange and specialty citrus and other crop markets are intensely competitive, but no single producer has any significant market power over any market segments, as is consistent with the production of most agricultural commodities. Generally, there are a large number of global producers that sell through joint marketing organizations and cooperatives.
rows.note: FY2012(10月期)10-K(2013-01-14)。原本自身が『no single producer has any significant market power』『agricultural commodities』と構造を断定＝50の残余刻みが両側から確定。GLOBALGAPは自社取得の認証で規約の除外対象。

rows.quote: In addition, semiconductor manufacturers must make a substantial investment to qualify and integrate new capital equipment into semiconductor production lines. As a result, once a semiconductor manufacturer has selected a particular supplier's equipment and qualified it for production, the manufacturer generally maintains that selection for that specific production application and technology node as long as the supplier's products demonstrate performance to specification in the installed base.
rows.note: FY2012(6月期)10-K(2012-08-22)。顧客(半導体メーカー)の側が substantial investment を払って自社の量産ラインへ qualify する型で、認定後は同一プロセス・技術ノードで維持されると断定。願望形ではなく完了形。

rows.quote: We believe that barriers to entry into the promotion services business are low and that certain local promoters are increasingly expanding the geographic scope of their operations.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K(2013-02-26)。プロモーション事業は原本が『barriers to entry ... are low』と自認。チケッティングは会場との排他契約はあるが契約上の独占であって顧客側の再認定・移行費用の記述はなく、自社発券システムからの競争増大を明記。

rows.quote: We believe that the bases for competition are consistent quality, price and, most importantly, the ability to meet the runability and printability requirements of converting equipment and high-speed cigarette-making machines.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K(2013-03-01・当時Schweitzer-Mauduit)。顧客の高速製造機に合わせて設計され『developed, individually or in conjunction with customers』と共同開発を明記＝深い統合だが、顧客側の再認定・再試験の断定は無いので85には届かない。『limited the number of competitors』とも述べ50でもない。

rows.quote: We face competition in all aspects of our business. Competitors include large national and international companies and numerous local and regional companies. ... We compete primarily on the basis of product quality, brand recognition, brand loyalty, service, marketing, advertising and price.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K(2013-02-25)。原本が競合多数＋価格を競争基盤に挙げ、リスク項目でもretailer brands/private labelとの差別化困難を述べる。顧客側の再認定に当たる記述は皆無（qualif系ヒット0）。堀はブランドで、移行障壁の型ではない。

rows.quote: In each of the markets, price competition and market coverage are particularly important because there is limited differentiation among competing product lines.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K(2013-02-27)。原本が『limited differentiation among competing product lines』と代替容易性そのものを述べ、タイルは『highly fragmented』・木質は『over 100 wood flooring manufacturers』。顧客側の認定記述なし。

rows.quote: There are over 5,600 companies in the United States that produce construction aggregates. These include active crushed stone companies and active sand and gravel companies. The largest ten producers account for approximately 35% of the total market.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K(2013-02-22)。原本は生産者5,600社・上位10社35%＝断片化を述べ、競争基盤は『quarry or distribution location and price』。堀は輸送費と採掘許可（zoning/permittingが困難化し既存埋蔵の価値を高めると明記）で、顧客側の認定・移行障壁ではないためirrは50。

rows.quote: Commercial tax return preparers and electronic filers are highly competitive with regard to price and service, and many firms offer services that may include preparation of tax returns at no charge.
rows.note: COMPETITIVE CONDITIONS 節が『a substantial number of tax return preparation firms』と多数供給を自認し、無料提供まで挙げる＝価格競争型。顧客側の再認定・移行摩擦の記述は皆無（引用は競争記述で認定ロックの主張ではないため tense=なし）。

rows.quote: We believe that barriers to entry in our markets are not substantial, so the addition of new competitors can occur relatively easily, and customers enjoy significant flexibility in moving between competitors.
rows.note: 会社自身が『参入障壁は substantial ではない』『顧客は競合間を自由に移動できる』と明言＝50の教科書的事例。契約は年次入札・更新とも明記。

rows.quote: In general, there is intense competition among medical device companies. We compete with established medical technology companies in many of our product areas.
rows.note: CE Mark・FDA品質システム等の認証は全て『当社が取得する側』で規約の85から除外。外科医の切替コスト・顧客側の再バリデーションの記述をsurgeon/switch/validation等で走査したが不在。

rows.quote: We compete in an industry that is relatively new, intensely competitive and rapidly changing.
rows.note: COMPETITION節がCardCom/TriCom/L-1/DBIDS/Motorola/Honeywell等を名指し。米軍のATO・FIPS201は自社取得の認証で85に当たらず、ハードは大半がCOTS＝代替容易側。

rows.quote: Joint revenue sharing arrangements generally have a 10-year initial term are typically renewable by the customer for one or more additional terms of between 5 and 10 years. The Company has the right to remove the equipment for non-payment or other defaults by the customer. The contracts are generally non-cancellable by the customer unless the Company fails to perform its obligations.
rows.note: 10年ノンキャンセラブル契約＋装置の所有権は当社保持＋商標ライセンスの三重の摩擦＝高摩擦移行困難(70)。ただし顧客側の再認定の記述は無く、競合(他社ブランド大型3Dシアター)の存在も自認するので85には届かない。

rows.quote: Our products primarily compete based on performance, energy efficiency, integration, innovative design, features, price, quality, reliability, brand recognition and availability.
rows.note: Competition節はAMD/IBM/Oracle/ARMライセンシー(QCOM/NVDA/Samsung/TI)を名指しし価格を競争軸に挙げる。当社が主張する優位は『自社の製造網＋設計チーム』＝供給側の話で顧客側の移行障壁ではない。design win/qualif/switching/ecosystemを走査したが顧客ロックの記述は不在。

rows.quote: The DoD would have to incur significant expense to switch to a competing service provider for mobile satellite voice and data services similar to those we provide, and no other service provider can provide true global coverage or an interlinked mesh architecture that allows DoD traffic to flow through one secure, dedicated gateway.
rows.note: DoDが自前の専用ゲートウェイと端末に多額投資済みで『only compatible with our satellite network』＝顧客側の沈没投資による移行費用を完了形で断定。ただし機構は再認定ではなく設備互換なので85でなく70。『only ... true global coverage』の唯一供給主張は極域/DoD用途に限定で、商用MSSはInmarsat/Globalstar/ORBCOMMと『substantial competition』を自認するため全社ベースでは100を採らない。

rows.quote: OEM customers usually require long-lasting and well-established relationships, based on mutual trust, local proximity and a wide range of cooperative activities, starting from the design to the sampling, prototyping and testing phases of brake pads.
rows.note: 『Most automobile OEM platforms (car model) require specific brake pad formulations』＋設計→サンプリング→試作→試験の共同工程＝プラットフォーム単位の設計組込(70)。反対材料も記録: 別所で『Our markets are often fragmented and thus there are several types of competitors』と述べ、競争軸に価格を挙げる。qualif走査でも顧客側再認定の断定は無い。

rows.quote: Our manufacturing processes are generally not subject to significant proprietary protection.
rows.note: EMS。会社自身が製造工程に固有の保護が無いと明言し、Benchmark/Celestica/Flextronics/Hon-Hai/Sanmina等を名指し、さらに顧客の内製化(インソース)も競合として挙げる＝代替容易。ISO9001等は自社取得の認証。

rows.quote: The homebuilding industry and housing market are highly competitive with respect to selling homes; hiring trade labor, such as carpenters, roofers, electricians and plumbers; and acquiring attractive developable land.
rows.note: 住宅建設。『We compete for homebuyers ... against numerous homebuilders』『primarily compete with other homebuilders on the basis of selling price』＝価格競争・断片化。顧客は一回性で移行障壁の概念自体が無い。

rows.quote: We face competition for the acquisition of properties from a variety of investors, including domestic and foreign corporations and real estate companies, financial institutions, insurance companies, pension funds, investment funds, other REITs and individuals, some of which have significant advantages over us, including a larger, more diverse group of properties and greater financial and other resources than we have.
rows.note: 純賃貸REIT。Competition節は物件取得側の競争だけで、テナント側の移行障壁の記述はゼロ。長期リースだが更新オプション付きで、満了時に出て行かれる risk factor を自ら書く（If we are unable to re-rent properties upon the expiration of our leases）→代替容易の50。

rows.quote: A large portion of our hardware products are based on our SPARC microprocessor and Oracle Solaris operating system platform, which has a smaller installed base than certain of our competitors’ platforms and which may make it difficult for us to win new customers that have already made significant investments in our competitors’ platforms.
rows.note: 既存プラットフォームへの多額の投資が乗り換えを妨げる、というスイッチングコストの完了形の断定はあるが、顧客側の再認定・再試験の記述は皆無。同じ10-Kが『the low barriers to entry in many of our market segments』と自認する→85には届かず70。

rows.quote: The trucking industry is highly competitive and includes thousands of carriers, none of which dominates the market in which the Company operates. The Company's market share is less than 1%
rows.note: 『thousands of carriers』『market share is less than 1%』と原本が市場の断片化を明言し、競争は quality of service と price。GMが売上17%の顧客集中はあるが移行障壁ではない→50。

rows.quote: Our transmission and distribution business is minimally impacted when customers choose alternate electric or gas suppliers since we earn our return by providing transmission and distribution service, not by supplying the commodity.
rows.note: PSE&Gは franchised public utility で送配電はバイパス不能（引用）。だが最大セグメントは merchant の Power（2012年 純利益 647 vs PSE&G 528）で卸市場の競争品＋商品供給は顧客が他社へ migration 中。刻みが割れるので全社では高摩擦相当の70に置いた。

rows.quote: The off-road vehicle, snowmobile, motorcycle and small vehicle markets in the United States, Canada and other global markets are highly competitive. Competition in such markets is based upon a number of factors, including price, quality, reliability, styling, product features and warranties.
rows.note: 消費財で価格・仕様・スタイリングによる代替を原本が明記。EPA/CARBの排出認証は当社が取得する側（自社取得の認証は規約で85の対象外）で、顧客側の再認定の記述なし→50。

rows.quote: Water & Fluid Solutions faces numerous domestic and international competitors, some of which have substantially greater resources directed to the verticals in which we compete.
rows.note: 多数の内外競合＋『competition focuses on brand names, product performance ... quality and price』。原子力用バルブ等の認証は『we must obtain certifications for our products or installations』＝自社取得で規約の除外対象→50。

rows.quote: Pursuant to authorizations from the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and the PUC, PPL Electric operates a regulated distribution monopoly in its service area. Accordingly, PPL Electric does not face competition in its electric distribution business.
rows.note: 規制3セグメント（PA/KY/UK＝2012年純利益の73%）が唯一供給と原本が明言（LKEは『There are currently no other electric public utilities operating within the electric service areas』、WPDは『regulated monopolies』）。残るSupply(27%)は『intense competition』と自認する点は留保。

rows.quote: Our depth of expertise and broad range of product offerings is the underlying basis for our position as a sole source provider of products to a majority of our OEM customers. We estimate that over 70% of the power systems that we supply are provided to our major OEM customers on a sole-source basis.
rows.note: OEM向けカスタム設計＋供給の70%超がsole-source＝設計組込の高摩擦。ただしEPA/CARB排出認証は当社が保有する側（規約の除外）で、顧客の再認定を要する断定は無い。油ガス向けの『We believe we are the only provider in this market that supplies pre-certified ... power systems』は開拓中の新市場かつ自称なので採らず→70。

rows.quote: We offer our customers access to our instrumentation via reagent rental agreements which place instrumentation with customers without requiring them to purchase the equipment. Instead, we recover the cost of providing the instrumentation in the amount charged for Sample and Assay Technology consumable products.
rows.note: 装置を顧客ラボに置き消耗品（売上87%）で回収するrazor-blade＝深い統合を原本が明記。一方Competition節はhome-brew法やPromega/Millipore等を名指しし『very competitive and price sensitive』とも書く。顧客側の再認定の記述は走査しても無し→70。

rows.quote: In each of the United States, Australia, and New Zealand, film patrons typically select the cinema that they are going to go to first by selecting the film they want to see, and then by selecting the cinema in which they would prefer to see it.
rows.note: 客は作品を先に選ぶ＝館は代替可能、と自社が明記。さらに『Our ability to obtain top grossing first run feature films may be adversely impacted by our comparatively small size』とRegal/AMCとの規模差を自認し、in-home娯楽との競合も記す→50。

rows.quote: We maintain positions on numerous high priority programs, including the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter, F/A-18E/F Super Hornet and V-22 Osprey. The large installed base of our products leads to attractive aftermarket sales and service opportunities.
rows.note: 名指しの機体プログラムに既に搭載され、別記で『design and development of new and unique controls or control systems to meet the customer's specifications』＝顧客仕様への専用設計を述べる＝設計組込。ただし全227千字に『FAA』が0回、requalification/認定ロックの記述も皆無で、競争節は『conformity to customer specifications, timeliness of delivery』等の一般競争要因のみ→85には届かず70。

rows.quote: The Company encounters strong competition from other insurance and reinsurance brokerage firms that operate on a nationwide or worldwide basis, from a large number of regional and local firms in the United States, the European Union and elsewhere, from insurance and reinsurance companies that market, distribute and service their insurance and reinsurance products without the assistance of brokers or agents
rows.note: 多数の全国・地域ブローカーに加え保険会社の直販（仲介飛ばし）まで代替経路として自認。別記で顧客が複数ブローカーへ口座を分割する『syndicated/distributed』傾向が競争を強めるとも述べる＝移行障壁の記述なし→50。

rows.quote: The personals business is very competitive and highly fragmented and barriers to entry are minimal.
rows.note: 原本はIAC/InterActiveCorpの10-K（2013年当時Matchは同社の一セグメント）。Match節が自ら『highly fragmented』『barriers to entry are minimal』と断定＝50の典型。全社ではSearch&Applicationsの収益がGoogleとのサービス契約に依存する旨も記載。

rows.quote: Competition is intense in our existing and potential markets. Our competitors in the United States and abroad are numerous and include, other molecular diagnostic companies, diagnostic reference laboratories, large multi-national healthcare companies, and universities and other research institutions.
rows.note: 堀の主張は全て自社保有・自社ライセンスの特許（BRAC Analysisが売上81.7%）＝当社が取得する側の権利で85の対象外。『others may independently develop substantially equivalent technologies』と代替可能性も自認。唯一供給の断定は全文に無し→50。

rows.quote: Our equipment is sold in competition with a wide variety of alternative bonding, sealing, caulking, finishing, coating, testing and inspection, and fluid management techniques .
rows.note: 競争節が代替『技術・工法』との競合と価格を競争要因に挙げる。顧客工程への統合（Advanced Technology Systems）は述べるが、移行障壁・再認定・スイッチングコストの記述は一つも無い→50。堀の印象は直販/技術サービス網と消耗品で強めだが原本は主張していない。

rows.quote: Competition —The TiO 2 industry is highly competitive. Kronos competes primarily on the basis of price, product quality, technical service and the availability of high performance pigment grades.
rows.note: 自社グレードの大半を『commodity pigments』と自認し価格競争を第一の競争基盤と明記。『high barriers to entry consisting of high capital costs, proprietary technology and significant lead times』は業界一般論で顧客側の負担が書かれておらず85の対象外→50。

rows.quote: Once certain products of our Precision Motion and Technologies segment and Laser Products segment have been designed into a given OEM customer’s product or system, there are generally significant barriers to subsequent supplier changes.
rows.note: OEM製品への設計組込後の供給者変更障壁を完了形で断定＝70の定義そのもの。ただし障壁の中身（顧客側の再認定・再試験）は書かれず『significant barriers』止まりなので85には上げない。原本はGSI Group名義。

rows.quote: The human resources services industry, including the PEO industry, is highly fragmented. Many PEOs have limited operations and fewer than 1,000 worksite employees, but there are several industry participants that are comparable to our size or larger.
rows.note: 自ら『highly fragmented』と断定し、給与処理会社・保険会社・人事コンサルからの代替競合も列挙。競争は『quality of services, scope of services, ... reputation and price』＝価格を含む→50。契約解約の増加リスクも自認。

rows.quote: A substantial investment is required by the customers to evaluate, test, select and integrate capital equipment into a production line. As a result, once a manufacturer has selected a particular vendor’s capital equipment, we believe that the manufacturer generally relies upon that equipment for the specific production line application and frequently will attempt to consolidate its other capital equipment requirements with the same vendor.
rows.note: 最も85に近い境界例。顧客側の評価・試験・統合の投資負担と選定後の固着を完了形で述べるが、指示された85の実例が全て要求する『再認定・再試験・データ再生成をやり直す』断定は無く、qualificationの語は販売サイクル遅延のリスク要因（初回導入時）としてのみ登場→規約どおり70。加えて『the semiconductor capital equipment industry is intensely competitive』とNanometrics/Rudolph/KLA-Tencorを同種製品の競合として名指し、統合型はPEM（Applied Materials等）への依存も自認。

rows.quote: The medical devices industry is highly competitive. We compete with a large number of companies, many of which have significantly greater financial, manufacturing, marketing, distribution and technical resources than we do. Many of our competitors may be able to develop products and processes competitive with, or superior to, our own.
rows.note: 多数の競合が同等以上の製品を出しうると自認。認証の言及はFDA承認等の自社取得側のみ（85の対象外）、GPOから供給者除外されうるリスクも記載＝顧客側の切替障壁は無い→50。

rows.quote: Historically, the construction business has not typically required large amounts of capital for smaller contracts, which can result in relative ease of market entry for companies possessing acceptable qualifications.
rows.note: 公共土木の競争入札（lowest bidder）。prequalification は当社が発注機関から取る側で顧客の再認定ではなく、原本自身が「市場参入は比較的容易」と述べる＝残余刻み50。

rows.quote: At our Middletown, Indiana Harbor and Granite City cokemaking facilities, coke is delivered primarily by a conveyor belt leading to the customer’s blast furnace.

rows.quote: The lime industry is highly regionalized and competitive, with quality, price, ability to meet customer demands and specifications, proximity to customers, personal relationships and timeliness of deliveries being the prime competitive factors.
rows.note: 原本が競争要因の筆頭に品質と価格を置き、顧客側の再認定も切替費用も一切書いていない。高い参入障壁は述べるが中身は石灰石鉱区の希少性・許認可・立地＝供給側の障壁で、顧客が乗り換える負担の記述ではない。

rows.quote: These agreements, which range in terms from one to thirteen years, can provide card issuance and/or conversion support, volume / growth targets and marketing and program support based on specific performance requirements.
rows.note: 最長13年の顧客契約＋当社が『conversion support』を負担する記述＝乗り換えに費用が要ることの間接証拠、加えてVisaNetへの接続と共通operating regulationsへの服従＝深い統合で70。顧客側の再認定の断定は全文になく85は取れない（Durbinで複数ネット併載・ルーティング選択が義務化された記述はむしろ摩擦を下げる側）。

rows.quote: The apparel and footwear industries are highly competitive, and VF's success depends on its ability to respond to constantly changing markets. VF competes with numerous apparel and footwear brands and manufacturers. Competition is generally based upon brand name recognition, price, design, product quality, selection, service and purchasing convenience.
rows.note: 原本自身が多数の競合と価格を競争基盤に挙げる。qualification/certification の語は自社工場のWRAP認証と契約工場の事前認証＝当社が取得・課す側で、顧客側の負担は皆無。

rows.quote: These groups mandate rigorous manufacturer certification, new product testing and approval processes that we believe are difficult for new entrants to meet cost-effectively and efficiently without the scale and extensive experience we possess.
rows.note: AAR/FRAが製造者認定と新製品試験・承認を課す＝第三者認定の機構は実在するが、原本の書きぶりは『新規参入者に難しい』であって顧客側の再認定費用の断定が無いので70。補強材料に『Our substantial installed base ... these customers often look to purchase safety- and performance-related replacement parts from the original equipment components supplier』＋新製品は既存機器とinteroperableである必要、がある一方で『Price competition is strong because we have a relatively small number of customers and they are very cost-conscious』と自認。

rows.quote: Due to the commodity nature of many of our products, competition in these markets is based primarily on price and to a lesser extent on performance, product quality, product deliverability and customer service. As a result, we generally are not able to protect our market position for these products by product differentiation and may not be able to pass on cost increases to our customers.
rows.note: 会社自身が商品性（コモディティ）と価格競争、製品差別化で市場地位を守れないことを明言。認定・切替費用の記述は全文に無い。

rows.quote: New products that we develop may require separate approval as medical devices, and products that are intended to be used in packaging and delivery of pharmaceutical products will be subject to both customer acceptance of our products and regulatory approval of the customer's products following our development period.
rows.note: 部材の採用に『顧客の製品の側の規制当局承認』が必要と原本が明記＝再認定の費用が顧客側に落ちる機構。ただし書きぶりは新製品の採用（これから承認を得る）方向で、既存供給者を外すと顧客が再申請を要するという完了形の断定は無い＝85の中では弱い型として記録する。『Commercial development ... commonly requires several years』も併記。

rows.quote: Aerospace industry safety regulations and manufacturing standards demand significant product certification requirements, which form a basis for competition as well as a barrier to entry.
rows.note: 政府規制による製品認定＋OEMの機体・エンジン計画への設計組込（G650/F-35等に content）と据付機のアフター供給で移行摩擦はあるが、認定は当社が取得する側で顧客側の再認定負担の記述が無いので70。減点材料として原本が『many of our OEM customers are capable of developing and manufacturing these same products internally』『Several competitors are also customers』と自認。

rows.quote: The retail food industry, in which our Concepts compete, is made up of supermarkets, supercenters, warehouse stores, convenience stores, coffee shops, snack bars, delicatessens and restaurants (including the QSR segment), and is intensely competitive with respect to food quality, price, service, convenience, location and concept.
rows.note: 消費者が毎回選び直す業態で、原本も価格・立地・利便性の激烈な競争と自認。認定・切替費用の語は全文で訴訟のclass certificationしか出ない。

rows.quote: The supplies business is highly fragmented and competition is comprised of numerous competitors of various sizes depending on the geographic area.
rows.note: 競合を40社以上実名で列挙し、カード印刷では代替技術（ink-jet・embossing・laser engraving等）とサービスビューローが『viable alternatives』と明記。certificationの語は自社がVAR（販売店）に与える認定＝向きが逆。1,190万台の据付台数はあるが顧客側の移行障壁の記述は無い。
